build_module: build a Lightning training module for neural image compression with optional GAN discriminator and rate targeting
build_trainer: build a PyTorch Lightning trainer with W&B logging, DDP strategy, and checkpoint callbacks for compression model training
build_model: build a HyperpriorAutoencoderBase model from Hydra config with optional pretrained autoencoder weights loading
test_compression_model: test a trained compression model on multiple datasets by loading checkpoints and running evaluation dataloaders
log_wandb_images: log input and compressed output image mosaics to Weights & Biases during training and validation epochs
